public/vendor/aws-logo.png — the AWS mark used on the film thumbnail
====================================================================

WHAT IT IS
  A 2000x1125 RGBA PNG: the "aws" wordmark and the Amazon smile, inside an orange cloud outline,
  on a white fill. Used by scripts/thumb-film.mjs for `--mark aws`, embedded AS SUPPLIED —
  never recoloured, re-traced, re-proportioned or otherwise altered.

WHERE IT CAME FROM
  Supplied by the repo owner on 2026-10-29. The origin was not recorded at the time.

  TO BE COMPLETED BY THE OWNER before this is published anywhere:
    source URL      : ................................................................
    licence / terms : ................................................................
    permission      : ................................................................

WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
  "AWS", the Amazon smile and the AWS logo are Amazon's trademarks. Naming AWS in text to say
  accurately what a course is about is ordinary nominative use. Putting Amazon's LOGO on the cover
  of a video is a different act: it is the kind of use that can suggest Amazon produced or endorsed
  the course, and Amazon reserves it. Get that permission in writing before publishing under it.

  TWO THINGS WORTH CHECKING FIRST

  1. This is probably not Amazon's own lockup. Amazon publishes the "aws" wordmark with the smile
     beneath it. The orange cloud ring around it in this file is a third-party decoration: it is
     common on stock and icon sites, but a stylised presentation of someone's mark is HARDER to
     justify than the unaltered official one, not easier. If an AWS mark is going on the cover,
     the file to vendor here is the official asset from Amazon's own brand resources.

  2. A stock-site file carries the stock site's licence too, which is a separate permission from
     Amazon's and may not cover a monetised channel.

  `--mark book` (public/favicon.svg, this repo's own mark) needs none of this and is what ships
  until the boxes above are filled in. See output/thumbnails/README.md.
